method: Generated original atlases, alpha cleanup, measured crop boundaries and one anatomical scale per identity. No tree falls or human poses were drawn procedurally.

prompts.infantry:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one 2D PIXEL sprite animation atlas for adult modern regular infantry, game GREYLINE. Image reference is IDENTITY, ANATOMY and pixel STYLE reference only. New poses required, not copying its repeated raised-rifle frames.
EXACTLY 4 columns x 3 rows =12 equal cells. Transparent alpha background, no scenery, text, gridlines or labels. Full body visible with room around rifle and boots. ONE identical slim adult soldier in every cell, 7.5-head proportions, small realistic head, long adult legs, olive camouflaged uniform, olive helmet and vest, compact backpack, black assault rifle. Match reference worn military palette and crisp tiny square pixel clusters. Not chibi, not a toy, no thick comic outline, no smooth blur. Side view facing RIGHT.
First 8 cells (top two rows) form ONE complete LOW-READY WALK CYCLE. Soldier walks upright but alert with softly flexed knees; holds rifle with both hands low at waist, muzzle angled 25 degrees DOWN to right, butt below shoulder. NEVER aims shoulder-high in these 8 cells. Same scale, near-fixed pelvis center, constant ground baseline, very small natural torso bob only. Feet MUST visibly pass and alternate; do not repeat the same wide stride eight times.
Frame 0: NEAR leg reaches forward, heel first; FAR leg behind, toe touching ground, widest stride.
Frame 1: near front foot becomes FLAT and knee takes weight; far heel lifts and begins coming forward.
Frame 2: near leg supports vertically under hips; far knee bends and passes beside it, far foot clearly off ground. Feet close together, NARROW silhouette.
Frame 3: near supporting foot pushes back; far thigh swings FORWARD with bent knee and raised toe. Intermediate stride.
Frame 4: FAR leg now reaches far forward heel-first; NEAR leg is far behind on toe. Opposite leg from frame 0 is forward, clear near/far shading.
Frame 5: far front foot flat takes weight, near back heel lifts.
Frame 6: far leg vertical under hips, near knee bends and passes beside it, near foot OFF ground; NARROW silhouette opposite frame 2.
Frame 7: far foot pushes back, near leg swings forward with bent knee before next heel contact.
Bottom row four cells: ALL stand on identical planted feet, no walking:
8 relaxed low-ready idle, rifle at waist angled25 degrees DOWN;
9 raising rifle halfway, butt approaches chest, muzzle12 degrees down;
10 butt settles into shoulder, elbows lift, muzzle almost horizontal;
11 fully shouldered aiming rifle horizontal RIGHT, matching the reference adult stance.
Preserve identity and equipment through all12. Each intermediate must be genuinely redrawn; action readable at approximately64-pixel body height, substantial knee/foot separation differences. No duplicated walk contact poses masquerading as middle frames.
